spans.s:
n. (-तं)
1 Measure in general.
2 An assemblage of young women.
E.
यु to mix, deriv. irr., or युवती a young woman, aff. अण्.

n. (-नं)
1 Youth manhood.
2 An assemblage of young women.
E.
युवन young, अण् aff.

m. (-कः)
Pimples on the face, especially in young persons.
E.
यौवन youth, and कण्टक a thorn.

m. (-र्पः)
Pride of youth, rashness, conceit.
E.
यौवन, and दर्प pride.

f. (-शा)
The period of youth.
E.
यौवन, and दशा state.

f. (-का)
Blotches or pimples on the face in youth.
E.
यौवन, and पिडका a pimple.

n. (-णं)
1 The breast, the bosom.
2 Beauty, handsomeness.
E.
यौवन youth, लक्षण mark or sign.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
Youthful.
E.
यौवन, and मतुप् aff.

m. (-श्वः)
A name of MĀNDHĀTĀ, one of the kings of the solar dynasty.
E.
युवनाश्च a proper name, and अण् patronymic aff.
